dataset: NYC TLC yellow taxi trips, January 2023
license: NYC Open Data terms / public TLC records
selection: Systematic source-order sample: every 50th row, starting at row 0, from 3,066,766 source records. Original source fields retained; this is not the complete month.
notes: Attribution: NYC Taxi and Limousine Commission and reporting providers. Parquet converted to CSV without invented trips. Completed pickups are a sampled activity proxy, not full demand counts or observations of available supply/unserved demand. Account for sampling when aggregating; one month limits temporal generalization. Timestamp anomalies and other source-quality problems are retained for audit.
